Dialogs.Dialog: Really？ I don't think that's true.
It is true. It's been less often.
(She seems a little unhappy about it.)
Haha, now I'm curious. What's up？
Well, lately... I get lonely with so few texts... Just kidding.
You don't text me much lately. Could it be you got bored of me？
Really？ It's not that I'm bored, but...
There's something that's been bothering me a little.
You know. Do you... not like kissing me？
You don't... very often, right？ So...
Then I think it's normal to do it. Probably.
Hey, why haven't you kissed me lately？
Huh... haven't I？ Isn't it different for everyone？
I... I feel like it's not enough.
Geez, I'm being serious here, you know？
I have something to say to you.
Lately you keep standing me up on dates. Why？
So you do know what I mean？
You know, there's something bothering me.
Lately, you haven't been keeping our date promises.
I want you to take your promises to me more seriously...
Lately, you keep standing me up on dates, don't you？
I don't like it when you do that...
Hey. Something's been bothering me a little.
The other day, you were silent the whole date. You ignored me, didn't you？
Don't you think that's really rude...？
Something's been bothering me, can I ask？
On our last date, you ignored me and stayed silent the whole time.
Did I do something？ When you treat me like that...
You know, I'm a little mad...
On our last date, you ignored me, didn't you？
Geez. If you're going to apologize, don't do it in the first place.
(I put her in a bit of a bad mood...)
I want to talk about something... okay？
We... haven't been seeing each other much lately, have we？
I think two people who are dating should be together more.
Um... we haven't been seeing each other much lately, have we？
Oh, now that you mention it...
If things go on like this...
You know. I think we've been seeing each other less lately.
I want to see you more, you know？ Don't you？
(Hmm, she seems to be building up some frustration.)
You sure are popular, aren't you？
Well, you were chatting so happily with that person just now.
Ah... was I？ I was just talking normally...
Hey, is that person a friend？ You two get along well.
Well, we get along pretty well, I guess. Something bothering you？
I see. Well, we're just friends.
No, it's fine. Getting jealous isn't good, is it？
You seemed really close with that person earlier.
Don't get too close with other girls, okay...？ Just kidding.
My fever's going down, so I think I'll be fine after a bit more rest.
Um, I've been wondering... did you catch that cold from me？
Not necessarily. So don't worry about it.
Give it to me next time
I'll be careful from now on
I think I'll be fine after a bit more rest. Thank you.
Um... did you catch my cold after all？
No way... I'm sure that's not it. Don't worry about it？
Is your cold getting worse？ Are you okay？
I'm fine. Papa says I'll be okay if I take my medicine and sleep.
That's good, but... I think you might have caught it from me.
If it's your cold, I don't mind catching it... Just kidding. Don't worry, I'll get better.
Next time, give it to me.
If we kept doing that, it'd never end, right？ But thank you. I'm happy you'd say that...
...Thank you. Those words are enough, so don't worry.
No... I don't want to see you suffer. Don't feel responsible.
I'll be careful from now on...
I'm really sorry. That's all I can say.
It's okay. As long as you're well, then...
Don't make that face. I'm happy you came to visit me...
Oh right. I cut some apples, can you eat some？
Really？ Then since you went to the trouble... feed me▼ ...Just kidding.
Thank you for today... Seeing your face seems to have given me energy.
If you're like this, I'm relieved. I'll be waiting to see ▲高嶺＊＊▲ back to her energetic self.
Yes. Papa even gave me his official seal of full recovery.
Oh, don't make a big deal of it. Our house has a great doctor, so there's nothing to worry about.
(I wish I could have helped too...)
Looks like your cold's better. That's good.
Thanks for worrying about me. A good night's sleep did it.
Um... sorry I couldn't visit you.
Ah... don't worry. Even if you'd come, I couldn't have been a proper host.
Are you feeling a hundred percent？
A hundred percent. I train regularly, so I'm fine now.
I see, I missed my chance to have you nurse me... Just kidding.
(She doesn't seem to mind... but I should've gone.)
Looks like you've recovered. What a relief.
Thank you. ...Are you okay？ Since we kissed...
Good... that's a relief for me too.
Thanks for worrying. How about you？ You didn't... catch it？
Good... I thought I might have given it to you that way...
Totally. What about you, you didn't catch it？
I see... so it didn't pass on through a kiss...
How are you feeling？ Everyone in the club was worried too.
I see... I've got everyone worried too.
They say you get over a cold if you give it to someone else... I wonder if that's true？
Only one way to find out...
Get plenty of rest. Papa says rest is the best medicine for a cold...
Right. I'll have to hold back on all sorts of things for now...
Hey, they say you get over a cold if you give it to someone... I wonder if that's true？
How are you feeling？ You need to rest right now.
Right... I need to take it easy...
They say you get over a cold by giving it to someone, right？ Is that... a theory you can trust？
Huh？ Well, I guess we have to try it... right？
Try it？ You mean... well... okay.
Huh...？ Geez, you're actually feeling fine, aren't you？
Trying again？ Well, since it's for you...
Yeah, I feel like I'm getting better. Thanks.
...So that means I caught your cold？
(It won't actually pass to her, right...)
Whoa... I think I'm getting some energy back.
Good. The experiment was a success... Just kidding.
(No way it actually passes to her, right...)
You're supposed to be resting... is this okay？
It's fine. Thanks to you, I'm overflowing with energy.
Really？ Then all that's left is for me to fight off the cold.
(It's not like it'll really pass to her...)
But hey, thanks to that, my body feels lighter.
Really？ Then if I catch a cold, come visit me properly, okay？
Good. Now get plenty of rest.
Thanks. You gave me some power, so I'll do my best to get better.
With that... did it pass to me？
I wonder. I do feel better, though.
If I catch it, maybe you'll come visit me.
I don't think that's how it works...
Right... sorry, I said something weird.
A superstition... I think Papa said that too...
Oh right, I made rice porridge. Can you eat some？
Thanks for visiting today. I'll get better soon.
I'll be waiting. But don't push yourself. Take care.
How are you feeling？ All better now？
Good... it's been on my mind the whole time.
I see. Sorry to worry you.
I'm fine, I'm fine. It wasn't a big deal to begin with.
I see. But no pushing yourself today, okay？
Yeah. I'll be careful not to have a relapse.
All better？ Now you can get back to practice.
Yeah, I had everyone worried too.
True, but I'm the one who was most worried, you know？
I know, I know. Thanks, I'm all better now.
Thanks to ▲高嶺＊＊▲ visiting me, I'm fully recovered.
Amazing. Maybe exercising regularly paid off？
Maybe... how about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ You didn't catch my cold？
I'm fine. Maybe that's thanks to the tennis club too... Just kidding.
Thanks for visiting. Thanks to you, I got better fast.
I'm glad... now we can be together again.
So... how are you feeling, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ I didn't give it to you when we kissed...
Thanks to ▲高嶺＊＊▲ sharing her energy, I'm all better.
Maybe that kiss worked... Just kidding.
Ah... speaking of which, were you okay after that？ You didn't catch it？
As you can see. I may not look it, but I'm pretty tough.
(What？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲ seems a little different than usual...)
When I think about you. Um... you know？
When I think about you... sometimes the words won't come...
And then, more than anything, I just want to be with you...
I want to get even a little closer...
Please don't think I'm... shameless, okay？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲？ She seems a little different than usual...)
Ah, well... it was just sudden. That's all！
Nothing's gotten into me. It's only natural, isn't it？
So there's nothing to hold back, right？
I want you to dote on me a lot.
I want you to show your love for me, lots and lots.
...Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ just now was kind of...
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ seemed a little different than usual. More forward...)
Geez, don't say it... geez, what was I thinking...
(Will I get to see a bold ▲高嶺＊＊▲ like that again？)
Hehe, you were kind of cute just now.
No, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ was the cute one...
(She really is a little different. Bolder than ever...)
